title: Herb Roasted Peruvian Beef Anticuchos
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring roasted beef heart anticuchos with a glassy jelly made from perilla leaf kkaennip, served solo for a satisfying dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Thread the sliced beef heart onto skewers
In a bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and salt
Brush the mixture onto the beef heart skewers
Place the skewers in a bain-marie and roast in the oven for 20 minutes
Meanwhile, combine the chopped perilla leaf kkaennip, water, and gelatin in a saucepan
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes
Strain the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a bowl
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until set
Serve the roasted beef heart anticuchos with the glassy perilla leaf kkaennip jelly
